Anatomy

Price range

  1. 1.dr-range__titleThe zone's title, Price range, with .dr-range__sub saying what the price includes.
  2. 2.dr-range__histForty bars, one per ₴25 slice, standing on the rail: a picture of what services actually cost. One role="img" with a sentence for its label.
  3. 3.dr-range__bar--inA bar inside the chosen band: charcoal, 14.37:1. Out of band the bars stay --btn2, 1.25:1.
  4. 4.dr-range__fillThe chosen span on the rail, in charcoal.
  5. 5.dr-range__inputTwo native <input type="range"> on one rail: 24px solid charcoal thumbs in a 44px lane. Each has its own label and an aria-valuetext that says the money.
  6. 6.dr-range__valThe printed values, <output> elements under Minimum and Maximum.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Range.

When to use

The price range is the price control on listings and listings-filters, and the whole of that zone. A price slider with no distribution behind it asks the client to guess what is normal; the forty bars say it instead, and the bars inside the chosen band darken, so the control shows how much of the market the band actually covers. The chart is a picture of supply and never the carrier of the choice: the band is said by the thumbs, by the filled span and by the two printed values before the picture is read. The two native sliders take the arrow keys with no script (WCAG 2.1.1) and expose role, min, max and value with no ARIA patch (4.1.2).

The copy states figures only, the way voice.md P3 asks: Price range, Service price, all fees included, Minimum, Maximum, and the money. The histogram's label describes the distribution (most cost ₴200 – ₴350), never the selection.

Sources: inventory.md § 1.5 Range · kit.html Price range · voice.md P2, P3 · components/form.css

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Price range

Service price, all fees included

Minimum ₴600

Maximum ₴1,000+

The card on listings-filters: title, subtitle, the chart on the rail, two thumbs, two printed values, 341 × 254.98 at 16 inset all round.

Don’t

Price as three adjectives. Low, Medium, High carry no checkable figure, which is what voice.md P2 forbids; these presets came off the zone on the designer's word. A price is a number in this product. To pick one value from a short list that really is a list, use a checkbox or radio group.
